meta.title: Home Page shows the seven top summary metrics
gaps: Verify that each of the seven metric cards contains a value rather than an empty or missing value
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that each of the seven metric cards contains a value rather than an empty or missing value

steps.note: Open the Home page from the dashboard navigation.
Verify the Live Events metric label is present.
Verify the Total Events metric label is present.
Verify the Event Closed metric label is present.
Verify the Bids Received metric label is present.
Verify the Purchase Value metric label is present.
Verify the New Vendors metric label is present.
Verify the Engaged Vendors metric label is present.
Verify the default analytics period is shown as so far this month.
